qualifier: mitotic spindle orientation via astral microtubules
name: Centrosome anchoring and mitotic spindle orientation
rationale: All members concern placing and anchoring the centrosome/MTOC and its microtubules; spindle orientation, astral microtubules and asymmetric division separate it from centrosome-maturation, cytokinesis and centriole-duplication neighbours.

qualifier: fungi and Gram-positive bacteria, metal sequestration
name: Antimicrobial killing of fungi and Gram-positive bacteria
rationale: Members are effector defences that kill or starve microbes (cytolysis, metal sequestration, neutrophil cytotoxicity, antifungal humoral response); the fungal/Gram-positive targets distinguish it from neighbours centred on degranulation, respiratory burst or Gram-negative killing.

qualifier: M-CSF signaling, osteoclast fusion and bone resorption
name: M-CSF signaling in macrophage and osteoclast development
rationale: Members cover M-CSF/CSF1 signaling driving macrophage proliferation and fusion into bone-resorbing osteoclasts; M-CSF plus osteoclast/bone content separates it from GM-CSF/dendritic neighbours and DAP12-centred fusion neighbours.

qualifier: break-induced replication and resolution of recombination intermediates
name: Recombination-based telomere maintenance and break-induced replication
rationale: Members concern recombination-dependent telomere maintenance and capping (t-circles, D-loops, BIR); break-induced replication, DNA unwinding and resolution of mitotic recombination intermediates distinguish it from neighbours focused on C-strand synthesis, R-loops and fork reversal.

qualifier: methyl-DNA binding repression and sensory behaviour
name: MECP2-mediated neuronal gene repression and sensory behavior
rationale: Most members are MECP2 binding, phosphorylation and target-gene regulation with HDAC and translational repression, alongside Rett-relevant sensory behaviours; the MECP2/chromatin repression axis distinguishes it from behaviour- and brain-development neighbours.

qualifier: RhoA/B/C and CDC42 with formin activation
name: RhoA/B/C and CDC42 GTPase cycles with formins
rationale: Members are GTPase cycles of RhoA/B/C/D/G/J and CDC42 plus formin activation; the absence of RAC and RND cycles and presence of RhoA/B/C and formins separate it from neighbours.

qualifier: nutrient, incretin and KATP-channel control
name: Islet insulin secretion control by nutrients and incretins
rationale: Members cover beta-cell insulin processing and secretion governed by glucose sensing, fatty acids, GLP-1/GIP, autonomic input and KATP channels; this secretory side distinguishes it from neighbours centred on insulin receptor signaling and GLUT4 translocation.

qualifier: glycogen storage diseases and intestinal sugar absorption
name: Glycogen metabolism and intestinal hexose uptake
rationale: Members span glycogen synthesis/breakdown and its storage diseases plus dietary carbohydrate digestion and hexose transport; neighbours instead carry galactose catabolism, glycolysis/gluconeogenesis or urate transport.

qualifier: CCL5 and cGAS-STING enhancement
name: Dendritic cell CCL5 production with cGAS-STING enhancement
rationale: Members concern dendritic/myeloid cytokine and CCL5 chemokine production with positive cGAMP/STING input; CCL5 and STING promotion distinguish it from Th1/IL-12, CXCL-chemokine and STING-restraint neighbours.

qualifier: PUMA/NOXA BH3-only activation and cytochrome c release
name: p53-induced apoptosis via PUMA, NOXA and cytochrome c release
rationale: Members are p53 transcription of death genes and BH3-only (PUMA/NOXA) inactivation of BCL-2 leading to cytochrome c release; these distinguish it from BAX/BAK MOMP and generic p53 intrinsic-apoptosis regulation neighbours.

qualifier: cerebellar and striatal development, motor learning
name: Cerebellar and striatal development for motor coordination
rationale: Members are cerebellar layer formation, striatal development, locomotion, proprioception and motor learning; the motor focus separates it from neighbours with vocal, auditory and glial-development content.

qualifier: elongation brake, termination and R-loop processing
name: RNA polymerase II transcription control through termination
rationale: Members regulate Pol II transcription from preinitiation through elongation braking to poly(A)-coupled termination and R-loop processing; termination and R-loop content distinguish it from Pol I/III, RNA-processing and elongation-complex neighbours.

qualifier: telomerase assembly and Cajal body trafficking
name: Telomere maintenance including telomerase Cajal body trafficking
rationale: Members span telomere capping, C-strand synthesis, telomerase extension and recombination-based maintenance; telomerase holoenzyme assembly and Cajal body/scaRNA localization distinguish it from broad DNA-repair and senescence neighbours.

qualifier: proline and glutamine family
name: Proline and glutamine-family amino acid metabolism
rationale: Members are general alpha-amino acid metabolism terms plus proline synthesis and catabolism; proline/glutamine-family focus distinguishes it from serine/glycine and generic organic-acid neighbours.

qualifier: heme degradation and inherited hyperbilirubinemias
name: Bilirubin clearance and inherited hyperbilirubinemias
rationale: Members cover heme breakdown to bilirubin, its hepatic uptake by SLCO transporters, glucuronidation and biliary export, and their defects; heme/bilirubin content separates it from drug-ADME and xenobiotic transport neighbours.

qualifier: contractile force and heart rate regulation
name: Cardiomyocyte growth, proliferation and contractile regulation
rationale: Members regulate cardiomyocyte proliferation, hypertrophy, differentiation and survival plus contraction force and heart rate; striated cardiac focus separates it from smooth-muscle neighbours and contractility from a calcineurin-hypertrophy neighbour.

qualifier: membrane tubulation
name: Golgi ribbon organization and membrane tubulation
rationale: Members concern Golgi disassembly, reassembly, ribbon formation and positioning together with membrane tubulation; tubulation and Golgi architecture distinguish it from secretory, COPI and generic membrane-traffic neighbours.

qualifier: Rab GTPase prenylation and GEF/GAP control
name: Golgi vesicle traffic and organization with Rab regulation
rationale: Members cover COPI and intra-Golgi vesicle budding, tethering and fusion, Golgi architecture and ARF/Rab control; Rab geranylgeranylation and GEF/GAP members distinguish it from endosome-TGN-lysosome and COPII neighbours.

qualifier: proline-glycine transporter defects
name: Iminoglycinuria from defective proline-glycine transporters
rationale: All three members are SLC36A2/SLC6A20 defects causing iminoglycinuria and hyperglycinuria, which distinguishes it from Hartnup, cystinuria and other renal solute-transport neighbours.

qualifier: MHC class Ib recognition and T cell cytotoxicity
name: NK cell cytotoxicity regulation with MHC class Ib recognition
rationale: Members regulate NK (and T) cell activation, degranulation and killing with NK receptor signatures; MHC class Ib presentation and positive anti-tumour NK response distinguish it from KIR/granzyme and CD8 T cell neighbours.

qualifier: embryonic cartilage and joint morphogenesis
name: Chondrogenesis and embryonic joint morphogenesis
rationale: Members are chondrocyte proliferation, differentiation, hypertrophy and cartilage condensation plus joint morphogenesis; joint and cartilage morphogenesis distinguish it from ossification/tendon and articular cartilage homeostasis neighbours.

qualifier: direct alkylation damage reversal
name: Base excision repair and direct alkylation damage reversal
rationale: Members are BER steps and glycosylase defects plus ALKBH/MGMT direct reversal of alkylation; alkylation reversal and long-patch BER distinguish it from neighbours carrying mismatch repair, NEIL3 and damage-recognition steps.

qualifier: citrulline synthesis and OTC deficiency
name: Urea cycle citrulline synthesis and OTC deficiency
rationale: Members cover urea cycle citrulline/arginine synthesis and OTC variants; OTC specificity distinguishes it from neighbours with other urea-cycle enzyme defects and ammonium/ornithine metabolism.

qualifier: COPI retrograde traffic
name: COPI vesicle traffic between Golgi and ER
rationale: Members are vesicle targeting between ER and Golgi and COPI budding/retrograde transport; COPI distinguishes it from COPII and ER protein-targeting neighbours.

qualifier: BCR signaling cascade regulation
name: B cell development and BCR signaling regulation
rationale: Members cover B cell development, proliferation, homeostasis and BCR signaling (RAS, BTK, CD22 regulation) with B-cell expression modules; the BCR signaling cascade distinguishes it from plasma/germinal-centre and T-cell neighbours.

qualifier: NAD(P) salvage and phosphocreatine buffering
name: Nucleotide, NAD(P) and phosphocreatine energy-carrier metabolism
rationale: Members interconvert nucleotide phosphates, make and salvage NAD(P), handle creatine/phosphocreatine and transport ATP/ADP into mitochondria; NAD and creatine content distinguish it from nucleotide-biosynthesis, PRPP and apoptosis-linked neighbours.

qualifier: planar cell polarity
name: Planar cell polarity-driven convergent extension
rationale: Members are convergent extension in gastrulation, axis elongation and neural plate plus planar polarity establishment; PCP and convergent extension distinguish it from axial mesoderm/floor plate and non-canonical Wnt receptor neighbours.

qualifier: TLR2/4 bacterial sensing and NLRP inflammasomes
name: TLR2/4 bacterial sensing and NLRP3 inflammasome cytokine regulation
rationale: Members span TLR2/4/5 and LPS detection, NLRP1/3 inflammasome and IL-1 processing, and regulation of inflammatory cytokines; TLR2/4 sensing distinguishes it from pyroptosis/caspase-4/5 neighbours and inflammasomes from TRIF/MyD88-regulation neighbours.

qualifier: membrane protein insertion and COPII export
name: ER membrane protein insertion and COPII export
rationale: Members cover SRP and tail-anchored insertion into the ER membrane, ER retention and COPII cargo export; COPII export and multi-pass insertion distinguish it from ER folding/ERAD and connexin-trafficking neighbours.

qualifier: oncogenic pathway mutants and ERK negative feedback
name: RAF-MEK-ERK signaling, oncogenic mutants and feedback inactivation
rationale: Members are RAF/MAP2K/MAPK activation, signaling by BRAF/RAS/MAPK mutants and ERK dephosphorylation feedback; oncogenic mutants and feedback inactivation distinguish it from SOS/RIT and RAS-GAP neighbours.
